item.tib: bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa
item.coloph: dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa

item.tib: dpal gsang ba chen po rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rgyal po
item.skt: shrI ma hA g+hu h+ya badzra tsan+t+ra rA dza
item.coloph: rdzogs s+ho// //bla ma kh ras pa ne sang/ chogs dga'i 'byung nas mkhas pa chen pos bsgyur ba'o
